scientific_question: At fixed hidden64+24 coordinates and constant full carry, is the remaining c_proj trajectory error caused by restricting task-selected Givens pairs to a 64-neighbor candidate graph rather than allowing longer-range hidden-channel transport?

evidence_before_registration.interpretation: Dense c_proj motion is 99.32 percent orientation rather than radial motion. More stages inside the same radius improve instantaneous fitting but not the carried endpoint, so access to long-range task-selected channel pairs is the next isolated variable.

teacher_forcing_protocol.trajectory_reset: Each arm/layer starts once from exact dense step-0 c_proj and follows all 238 updates without phase reset.
teacher_forcing_protocol.per_step_target: Use recorded dense W[t+1]-W[t], remove dense decoupled weight decay, add the arm's prior compression residual with decay 1.0, fit 64+24 right-rotation stages, then apply weight decay once.
teacher_forcing_protocol.matching: The same deterministic task-conditioned fast matcher selects 64 and 24 disjoint stage matchings from radius-specific candidate graphs. Radius changes candidates, not selected coordinate count.
teacher_forcing_protocol.interpretation: This is an optimistic transport-capacity oracle; no LM loss is evaluated.

metrics.aggregate: Energy-weight endpoint recovery across five layers, residual error-energy ratio, maximum feedback ratio, requested-update recovery, and per-layer wins.

registered_decision_rule.candidate_pass: All metrics must be finite. Candidate endpoint recovery must be no worse than neighbors64 at every score step; terminal unrecovered endpoint energy must be at most 0.85x control; terminal maximum feedback norm must be at most 0.95x control; terminal mean requested-update recovery must be no worse than control; and candidate must win at least 4/5 terminal layers.
registered_decision_rule.selection: Choose the first passing radius. If neither passes, retain neighbors64 and close the radius-only branch.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_pass: Implement only the selected radius at unchanged 64+24 stages, add tests, then separately preregister and directly poll an exact 124M >=20% MFU preflight. No language-model training is authorized by this plan.
registered_decision_rule.authorization_on_failure: Do not implement or train a wider radius. Move to a qualitatively different task-conditioned right-orbit factorization rather than more stages or a learned basis.
